marks.gloss_en: one may tie the jaw [of the dead] -- so that it not go further
one may not shut [the eyes of] the dead on Shabbat
והיינו דאמר רבי יוחנן: במתים חפשי -- this is what R' Yochanan said: once a person dies he is free of the mitzvot
RSBG: for a living day-old infant one desecrates Shabbat
שנאמר ומוראכם וחתכם יהיה -- dread lies on the creatures only while a person lives
RShbE: a living day-old infant need not be guarded from the weasel and the mice
שנאמר: אדם ביקר בל ילין נמשל כבהמות נדמו (Ps 49:13)
הא קא חזינן דנפיל? -- but we see that it does fall [upon two]!
ההוא כדרמי בר אבא -- that [case] is as Rami bar Abba said: no beast overpowers a man until he seems to it like a beast (= p_rami_nidme_kibehema)
Rav Pappa: we hold that a lion does not fall upon two
ואף שלמה אמר בחכמתו: וזכור את בוראיך בימי בחורותיך עד אשר לא יבאו ימי הרעה
RShbE: act while you find [opportunity], while it is available to you, and while you are still in your own hand
שנאמר: כי לא יחדל אביון מקרב הארץ (Deut 15:11)
Shmuel: there is no difference between this world and the days of the Messiah except subjugation to the kingdoms alone
שנאמר: כי בגלל הדבר הזה (Deut 15:10)
והא קא חזינן דמיעני! -- but we see that they do become poor!
אם איתא דמיעני, אהדורי אפתחא לא מהדר -- if he does become poor, he does not go round from door to door
R' Elazar HaKappar: a person should always pray for mercy concerning this condition [poverty], for if it does not come to him it comes to his son, and if not to his son, to his grandson
קרא קא כתיב: כי בגלל הדבר הזה, ותנא דבי רבי ישמעאל: גלגל הוא שחוזר בעולם
ונתן לך רחמים ורחמך והרבך -- whoever has compassion is shown compassion
מילט קא לייטת להו?! -- are you cursing them [our children, that they should need bread]?
קרא קא כתיב: כי בגלל הדבר הזה, ותנא דבי רבי ישמעאל: גלגל הוא שחוזר בעולם -- it is a verse that is written, not a curse
R' Chiyya to his wife: when a poor man comes, be quick to give him bread, so that [others] will be quick [to give] to your children
סבר לה כי הא דאמר רבי יוחנן משום רבי יוסי בן קצרתה: tears of weeping are bad [for the eyes]
תרנגולתא אפיקת מביתך?! -- is it a hen you have put out of your house?
תרתי -- תכלא ועיורא: [should I suffer] two, bereavement and blindness? (= p_tartei_tchala_veivra)
R' Chanina's daughter died, and he did not weep over her
one who shuts [a dying person's eyes] as the soul departs is a shedder of blood
'before the sun and the light are darkened' -- this is the forehead and the nose
Rav Nachman: kohl until forty years enlarges [the sight]; from then on, even as thick as a weaver's pin, it maintains but does not enlarge
וכן הוא אומר: וזריתי פרש על פניכם -- the verse speaks of פרש
and so it says: 'and I will spread dung upon your faces, the dung of your festivals' (Mal 2:3)
והאמר רב יהודה אמר שמואל: מעשה בתלמידו של רבי מאיר... אין מדיחין... אין סכין -- R' Meir forbade rinsing and oiling the [bathhouse] floor; how then may one oil and rinse the dead?
קרקע בקרקע מחלפא, מת בקרקע לא מיחלף -- ground is confused with ground; a corpse is not confused with ground
an incident: R' Meir's student, entering the bathhouse after him, wished to rinse the floor -- he told him: one does not rinse; to smear the floor with oil -- he told him: one does not smear
'all' -- to include what? to include what the Rabbis taught: one brings cooling vessels and metal vessels and places them on [the corpse's] stomach
and Solomon too said in his wisdom: 'before the silver cord is snapped, and the golden bowl is shattered, and the pitcher is broken at the fountain, and the wheel runs into the pit' (Eccl 12:6)
